"""Small immutable source snapshots and untimed process observations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import time
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceFile:
    name: str
    path: str
    sha256: str
    text: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FrozenSources:
    files: tuple[SourceFile, ...]
    archive_path: str
    archive_sha256: str

    def hashes(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {source.name: source.sha256 for source in self.files}

    def archive(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {"path": self.archive_path, "sha256": self.archive_sha256}


def freeze_sources(paths: Mapping[str, Path], output: Path) -> FrozenSources:
    """Read declared small source files once and retain their exact UTF-8 bytes.

    A content-addressed exclusive-create archive is never overwritten. The
    snapshot describes on-disk source at setup; it is not checkpoint storage
    or proof that external dependencies match those bytes.
    """
    sources: list[SourceFile] = []
    for name, path in sorted(paths.items()):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        sources.append(
            SourceFile(
                name, str(path), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), data.decode("utf-8")
            )
        )
    payload = (
        json.dumps(
            {"schema_version": 1, "files": [asdict(source) for source in sources]},
            indent=2,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            allow_nan=False,
        )
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    archive_hash = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    archive = output.with_suffix(f".sources-{archive_hash[:16]}.json")
    archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        with archive.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(payload)
    except FileExistsError:
        if archive.read_bytes() != payload:
            raise ValueError(
                "Existing source archive differs from its identity"
            ) from None
    return FrozenSources(tuple(sources), str(archive), archive_hash)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProcessDiagnostic:
    wall_time_ns: int
    perf_counter_ns: int
    user_seconds: float
    system_seconds: float
    minor_faults: int
    major_faults: int
    voluntary_context_switches: int
    involuntary_context_switches: int
    load_average: tuple[float, float, float] | None
    load_average_error: str | None
    collection_elapsed_ns: int
    device_memory_bytes: dict[str, int] | None = None


def process_diagnostic(
    *, device_memory_bytes: Mapping[str, int] | None = None
) -> ProcessDiagnostic:
    """Read cumulative own-process counters; no causal interpretation is implied."""
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    wall = time.time_ns()
    usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
    load: tuple[float, float, float] | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    try:
        load = os.getloadavg()
    except (AttributeError, OSError) as exc:
        error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    return ProcessDiagnostic(
        wall,
        start,
        usage.ru_utime,
        usage.ru_stime,
        usage.ru_minflt,
        usage.ru_majflt,
        usage.ru_nvcsw,
        usage.ru_nivcsw,
        load,
        error,
        time.perf_counter_ns() - start,
        None if device_memory_bytes is None else dict(device_memory_bytes),
    )

"""Verify frozen reference inputs without importing a tensor backend."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Protocol, cast

from wyat.backends.kai.encoding import EncodedRequest
from wyat.benchmark import BenchmarkCycle
from wyat.core import Request, decision_from_logits
from wyat.evaluation import EvaluationCase, EvaluationRow
from wyat.wire import read_object


class ReferenceEncoder(Protocol):
    model_id: str

    def encode_request(self, request: Request) -> EncodedRequest: ...


def balanced_orders(loads: Sequence[int], repeats: int) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
    """Rotate distinct loads so each occupies every measurement position equally."""
    values = tuple(loads)
    if (
        not values
        or any(type(value) is not int or value < 1 for value in values)
        or len(set(values)) != len(values)
        or type(repeats) is not int
        or repeats < len(values)
        or repeats % len(values)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Use unique positive loads and balanced repetition count")
    return tuple(
        values[offset:] + values[:offset]
        for repeat in range(repeats)
        for offset in (repeat % len(values),)
    )


def read_reference(
    path: Path,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    encoder: ReferenceEncoder,
    *,
    dataset_sha256: str,
) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    document = read_object(path)
    raw = document["rows"]
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or len(raw) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("Reference must contain every declared case")
    if document["model_id"] != encoder.model_id:
        raise ValueError("Loaded model identity differs from frozen CPU reference")
    if document["dataset_sha256"] != dataset_sha256:
        raise ValueError("Reference dataset hash differs from declared cohort")
    rows: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for case, item in zip(cases, raw, strict=True):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("Reference row must be an object")
        encoded = encoder.encode_request(case.request)
        if (
            item["id"] != case.id
            or item["candidate_ids"]
            != [candidate.id for candidate in case.request.candidates]
            or item["token_ids"] != list(encoded.ids)
            or item["candidate_positions"] != list(encoded.candidate_positions)
            or item["query_position"] != encoded.query_position
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"Reference inputs differ for {case.id}")
        saved = item["legacy_logits"]
        if not isinstance(saved, list) or any(
            type(value) not in (int, float) for value in saved
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reference logits must be numbers")
        prediction = decision_from_logits(
            case.request,
            tuple(float(cast(float, value)) for value in saved),
            encoder.model_id,
        )
        rows.append(
            EvaluationRow(
                case.id,
                case.expected,
                "ok",
                prediction,
                prediction.selected in case.expected,
                0,
                None,
            )
        )
    return BenchmarkCycle(0, tuple(rows), 0, 0)

"""Confirm one CPU prefix load in an owned 180-second worker process."""

from __future__ import annotations

from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch


class Arguments(Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path
    batch_size: int
    worker: bool
    screen: bool


def main() -> None:
    parser = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--screen", action="store_true", help="first8 numerical screen; B8 only"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help="internal owned worker")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if args.screen and args.batch_size != 8:
        parser.error("First8 screen requires batch size8")
    if args.worker:
        from .study import study

        passed = study(
            args.model.resolve(),
            args.output.resolve(),
            args.batch_size,
            screen=args.screen,
        )
        raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)
    raise SystemExit(
        launch(
            __package__ + ".run",
            args.model.resolve(),
            args.output.resolve(),
            timeout=180,
            worker_args=(
                "--batch-size",
                str(args.batch_size),
                *(("--screen",) if args.screen else ()),
            ),
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def verify_files(pins: dict[Path, str]) -> None:
    if any(digest(path) != expected for path, expected in pins.items()):
        raise ValueError("Pinned input, source or historical evidence changed")


def admit_history(results: Path = RESULTS) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Historical source identity comes from archives, never the live checkout."""
    verify_files({results / name: expected for name, expected in HISTORY.items()})
    prefixes: list[tuple[int, ...]] = []
    for batch in (8, 1):
        saved = read_object(results / f"torch-prefix77-b{batch}.json")
        archive = read_object(
            results / f"torch-prefix77-b{batch}.sources-d86eb841ae184bbb.json"
        )
        files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], archive["files"])
        table = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"])
        if len(files) != len(table) or len({item["name"] for item in files}) != len(
            files
        ):
            raise ValueError("Historical source inventory differs")
        for item in files:
            checksum = hashlib.sha256(cast(str, item["text"]).encode()).hexdigest()
            if checksum != item["sha256"] or table[cast(str, item["name"])] != checksum:
                raise ValueError("Historical archived source bytes differ")
        if (
            saved["completed"] is not True
            or saved["quality_passed"] is not True
            or saved["accepted"] is not True
            or saved["model_id"] != MODEL_ID
            or saved["dataset_sha256"] != DATA_SHA
            or saved["reference_sha256"] != REFERENCE_SHA
            or saved["input_sha256"] != INPUT_SHA
        ):
            raise ValueError("Historical full77 confirmation is unsupported")
        tokens = cast(list[int], saved["prefix_tokens"])
        if len(tokens) != 25 or any(type(token) is not int for token in tokens):
            raise ValueError("Historical exact25-token prefix differs")
        prefixes.append(tuple(tokens))
    if prefixes[0] != prefixes[1]:
        raise ValueError("Historical loads must use the same prefix")
    return prefixes[0]


def source_paths() -> dict[str, Path]:
    paths = {
        str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): path for path in (ROOT / "wyat").rglob("*.py")
    }
    for relative in (
        "benchmarks/__init__.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/__init__.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/evidence.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/reference.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/torch/process.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/torch/prefix/__init__.py",
        "docs/analysis/cpu/prefix.md",
        "tests/backends/cpu/test_reuse.py",
        "tests/analysis/test_cpu_prefix_production.py",
        "pyproject.toml",
    ):
        paths[relative] = ROOT / relative
    for path in Path(__file__).parent.glob("*.py"):
        paths[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = path
    for module in (
        modeling_qwen3,
        configuration_qwen3,
        cache_utils,
        masking_utils,
        sdpa_attention,
        modeling_rope_utils,
        activations,
        configuration_utils,
        modeling_utils,
        tokenization_utils_base,
        tokenization_utils_tokenizers,
        torch.nn.modules.module,
        torch.nn.modules.linear,
        torch.nn.modules.normalization,
        torch.nn.functional,
        torch.backends,
        torch.backends.cuda,
        torch.autograd.grad_mode,
        torch.amp.autocast_mode,
    ):
        paths[module.__name__] = Path(cast(str, module.__file__))
    return paths


def verify_sources(sources: FrozenSources) -> None:
    verify_files({Path(item.path): item.sha256 for item in sources.files})
    verify_files({Path(sources.archive_path): sources.archive_sha256})


def process_policy() -> dict[str, object]:
    """Observe shared settings; this assay never changes attention/precision policy."""
    return {
        "flash_sdpa": cast(Callable[[], bool], torch.backends.cuda.flash_sdp_enabled)(),
        "math_sdpa": cast(Callable[[], bool], torch.backends.cuda.math_sdp_enabled)(),
        "efficient_sdpa": cast(
            Callable[[], bool], torch.backends.cuda.mem_efficient_sdp_enabled
        )(),
        "cudnn_sdpa": cast(Callable[[], bool], torch.backends.cuda.cudnn_sdp_enabled)(),
        "float32_matmul_precision": torch.get_float32_matmul_precision(),
        "cpu_autocast": torch.is_autocast_enabled("cpu"),
    }


def performance(
    baseline: list[BenchmarkCycle], candidate: list[BenchmarkCycle]
) -> dict[str, float]:
    left = [cycle.latency_ms for cycle in baseline]
    right = [cycle.latency_ms for cycle in candidate]
    if (
        len(left) != 5
        or len(right) != 5
        or any(not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0 for value in (*left, *right))
    ):
        raise ValueError("All five finite positive paired cohort timings required")
    ratios = [a / b for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True)]
    return {
        "paired_median": percentile(ratios, 0.5),
        "paired_p05": percentile(ratios, 0.05),
        "aggregate_throughput_ratio": math.fsum(left) / math.fsum(right),
        "candidate_cohort_p95_ratio": percentile(right, 0.95) / percentile(left, 0.95),
    }


def speed_passed(observed: dict[str, float]) -> bool:
    return (
        observed["paired_median"] >= 1.02
        and observed["paired_p05"] > 1
        and observed["aggregate_throughput_ratio"] > 1
        and observed["candidate_cohort_p95_ratio"] <= 1
    )


def json_cycle(cycle: BenchmarkCycle) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Retain raw outcomes while making invalid clock evidence JSON-safe."""
    saved = cycle.to_dict()
    records = [saved, *cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"])]
    for record in records:
        value = cast(float, record["latency_ms"])
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            record.update(latency_ms=None, invalid_timing=repr(value))
    return saved


def require_timing(cycle: BenchmarkCycle) -> None:
    if (
        not math.isfinite(cycle.latency_ms)
        or cycle.latency_ms <= 0
        or any(
            not math.isfinite(row.latency_ms) or row.latency_ms < 0
            for row in cycle.rows
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("Finite positive cohort and nonnegative row timings required")


def study(model: Path, output: Path, batch_size: int, *, screen: bool = False) -> bool:
    if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size not in (1, 8):
        raise ValueError("Final-source confirmation requires batch size1 or8")
    if screen and batch_size != 8:
        raise ValueError("First8 numerical screen requires batch size8")
    if (
        output.exists()
        or output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").exists()
        or any(output.parent.glob(output.stem + ".sources-*.json"))
    ):
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing receipts; choose a new output")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gate = QualityGate()
    plan = BenchmarkProtocol(repeats=5, warmup=1, quality_gate=gate)
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "scope": "Final-source CPU prefix; fixed77 development, exposure unknown",
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "performance_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "screen_passed": False,
        "mode": "screen" if screen else "confirmation",
        "dispatch_observed": False,
        "threads_restored": False,
        "phase": "admission",
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
        "performance_gate": {
            "paired_median_minimum": 1.02,
            "paired_p05_minimum_exclusive": 1.0,
            "aggregate_throughput_ratio_minimum_exclusive": 1.0,
            "candidate_cohort_p95_maximum_ratio": 1.0,
        },
        "protocol": {
            "device": "cpu",
            "dtype": "float32",
            "threads": 8,
            "max_length": 512,
            "token_cache_size": 0,
            "prefix_length": 25,
            "screens": 0 if screen else 1,
            "warmup": 1,
            "pairs": 2 if screen else 5,
            "order": "warm AB; ordinary ABBA"
            if screen
            else "AB,BA,AB,BA,AB; screens/warmups AB",
            "attention": "sdpa; default process policies and native HF flags unchanged",
            "timing": "whole cohort; setup separate; fresh cache inside calls",
            "memory": "Logical prefix bytes; cumulative RSS; no memory ceiling",
            "promotion": "Both final-source B8 and B1 must pass all original gates",
        },
        "cycles": rows,
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    with output.open("x") as initial:
        initial.write(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    previous_threads = torch.get_num_threads()
    restoration_attempted = False

    def restore_threads() -> None:
        nonlocal restoration_attempted
        restoration_attempted = True
        try:
            torch.set_num_threads(previous_threads)
            if torch.get_num_threads() != previous_threads:
                raise ValueError("Original process thread count was not restored")
        except BaseException as error:
            payload["thread_restoration_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
            raise
        payload["threads_restored"] = True

    try:
        prefix = admit_history()
        inputs = {DATA: DATA_SHA, REFERENCE: REFERENCE_SHA}
        inputs.update(
            {model / name: checksum for name, checksum in MODEL_FILES.items()}
        )
        verify_files(inputs)
        sources = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        policy = process_policy()
        flags = {
            name: vars(sdpa_attention)[name]
            for name in (
                "_is_torch_mps_available",
                "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13",
            )
        }
        payload.update(
            source_sha256=sources.hashes(),
            source_archive=sources.archive(),
            historical_sha256=HISTORY,
            asset_sha256={str(path): checksum for path, checksum in inputs.items()},
            sdpa_flags=flags,
            process_policy=policy,
            runtime={
                "python": sys.version,
                "executable": sys.executable,
                "platform": platform.platform(),
                "torch": torch.__version__,
                "torch_git_version": torch.version.git_version,
                "torch_build": torch.__config__.show(),
                "packages": {
                    name: version(name)
                    for name in (
                        "torch",
                        "transformers",
                        "tokenizers",
                        "safetensors",
                        "numpy",
                    )
                },
                "mps_built": torch.backends.mps.is_built(),
                "mps_available": torch.backends.mps.is_available(),
                "prior_threads": previous_threads,
                "interop_threads": torch.get_num_interop_threads(),
            },
            source_scope=(
                "On-disk Python/dependency source and package/build observations; "
                "not independent attestation of every native binary/imported object"
            ),
            phase="loading",
        )
        write()
        if not all(value is True for value in flags.values()):
            raise ValueError(
                "Native masked-GQA flags differ from original admitted context"
            )
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line)) for line in DATA.read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77 or _input_digest(cases) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("All original ordered77 requests required")
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        if base.model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Released model identity differs")
        reference = read_reference(REFERENCE, cases, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA)
        encoded = tuple(base.encode_request(case.request) for case in cases)
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        candidate = PrefixScorer(base, prefix)
        build_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
        if not all(candidate._admits(row) for row in encoded):
            raise ValueError("Every original input must admit the frozen exact prefix")
        if screen:
            cases = cases[:8]
            reference = BenchmarkCycle(0, reference.rows[:8], 0, 0)
            encoded = encoded[:8]
        payload.update(
            model_id=MODEL_ID,
            dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA,
            reference_sha256=REFERENCE_SHA,
            input_sha256=_input_digest(cases),
            full_input_sha256=INPUT_SHA,
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            prefix_tokens=list(prefix),
            token_lengths=[len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
            prefix_build_ms=build_ms,
            prefix_state_bytes=candidate.prefix_state_bytes,
            phase="cycles",
        )
        write()
        engines = (
            BenchmarkEngine("cpu-full-prefill", Model(base, MODEL_ID), batch_size),
            BenchmarkEngine(
                "cpu-exact-prefix25", Model(candidate, MODEL_ID), batch_size
            ),
        )
        measured: tuple[list[BenchmarkCycle], list[BenchmarkCycle]] = ([], [])

        def verify_final() -> None:
            verify_sources(sources)
            verify_files(inputs)
            verify_files({RESULTS / name: sha for name, sha in HISTORY.items()})
            if process_policy() != policy or torch.get_num_threads() != 8:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Owned process attention, precision or threads changed"
                )

        with output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").open("x") as journal:

            def run(index: int, stage: str, repeat: int) -> BenchmarkCycle:
                verify_sources(sources)
                verify_files({RESULTS / name: sha for name, sha in HISTORY.items()})
                if process_policy() != policy or torch.get_num_threads() != 8:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Owned process attention, precision or threads changed"
                    )
                before = process_diagnostic()
                cycle = _run(engines[index], cases)
                successful = {
                    item.id
                    for item in cycle.rows
                    if item.status == "ok" and item.prediction is not None
                }
                row: dict[str, object] = {
                    "arm": engines[index].name,
                    "stage": stage,
                    "repeat": repeat,
                    "cycle": json_cycle(cycle),
                    "unknown_case_ids": [
                        case.id for case in cases if case.id not in successful
                    ],
                    "before": asdict(before),
                    "after": asdict(process_diagnostic()),
                }
                rows.append(row)
                try:
                    row["reference_quality"] = asdict(
                        compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), gate)
                    )
                finally:
                    journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    journal.flush()
                    write()
                require_timing(cycle)
                verify_sources(sources)
                return cycle

            if screen:
                warmup = (run(0, "warmup", 0), run(1, "warmup", 0))
                ordinary = (
                    run(0, "ordinary", 0),
                    run(1, "ordinary", 0),
                    run(1, "ordinary", 1),
                    run(0, "ordinary", 1),
                )
                quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * 6, warmup + ordinary, gate)
                paired = compare_cycles(
                    (ordinary[0], ordinary[3]), (ordinary[1], ordinary[2]), gate
                )
                verify_final()
                restore_threads()
                passed = quality.passed and paired.passed
                payload.update(
                    completed=True,
                    quality_passed=passed,
                    screen_passed=passed,
                    phase="complete",
                    reference_quality=asdict(quality),
                    paired_quality=asdict(paired),
                    source_verified_after=True,
                    asset_verified_after=True,
                    limits="First8 numeric screen; no dispatch or speed claim",
                )
                write()
                return passed
            screens = (run(0, "screen", 0), run(1, "screen", 0))
            if not compare_cycles((reference,) * 2, screens, gate).passed:
                verify_final()
                restore_threads()
                payload.update(completed=True, phase="rejected screen")
                write()
                return False
            payload["screen_passed"] = True
            warmup = (run(0, "warmup", 0), run(1, "warmup", 0))
            for repeat in range(5):
                for index in (0, 1) if repeat % 2 == 0 else (1, 0):
                    measured[index].append(run(index, "measured", repeat))
        cycles = screens + warmup + tuple(measured[0]) + tuple(measured[1])
        quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * 14, cycles, gate)
        report = BenchmarkReport(
            INPUT_SHA,
            cases,
            plan,
            *engines,
            tuple(measured[0]),
            tuple(measured[1]),
            compare_cycles(*measured, gate),
            (warmup[0],),
            (warmup[1],),
        )
        observed = performance(*measured)
        verify_final()
        restore_threads()
        passed = report.passed and quality.passed
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=passed,
            performance_passed=speed_passed(observed),
            accepted=passed and speed_passed(observed),
            phase="complete",
            report=report.to_dict(),
            reference_quality=asdict(quality),
            performance_observed=observed,
            source_verified_after=True,
            asset_verified_after=True,
        )
        write()
        return passed
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            performance_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        raise
    finally:
        if not restoration_attempted:
            try:
                restore_threads()
                write()
            except BaseException:
                payload.update(
                    completed=False,
                    quality_passed=False,
                    performance_passed=False,
                    accepted=False,
                    phase="failed",
                )
                write()
                raise

"""A hard wall cap for an experiment and only its owned process group."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path


def launch(
    module: str,
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    worker_args: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> int:
    if not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Timeout must be finite and positive")
    output = output.resolve()
    if any(output.parent.glob(output.stem + ".*")):
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing receipts; choose a new output")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        module,
        str(model),
        "--output",
        str(output),
        *worker_args,
        "--worker",
    ]
    environment = {**os.environ}
    if module.endswith("autotune"):
        environment.update(
            TORCHINDUCTOR_FREEZING="1",
            TORCH_LOGS="output_code",
            TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS="1",
        )
        environment["TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR"] = tempfile.mkdtemp(
            prefix="wyat-cpu-autotune-", dir="/private/tmp"
        )
    started = time.perf_counter()
    status: dict[str, object] = {
        "command": command,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
        "completed": False,
        "timed_out": False,
        "inductor_cache": environment.get("TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR"),
    }
    wall = output.with_suffix(".wall.json")
    wall.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n")
    code = 1
    with output.with_suffix(".log").open("w") as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            command, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=log, start_new_session=True
        )
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
            status["completed"] = code == 0
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            status["timed_out"] = True
            code = 124
        finally:
            # Workers inherit this new session; never signal another experiment.
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            child.wait()
    status.update(exit_code=code, elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started)
    wall.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return code

"""Selected final queries with full K/V and original absolute causal positions.

Callers supply penultimate suffix hidden states and maintained RoPE embeddings
for P..P+S-1, prepared before cache updates. The fresh stock cache is disposable:
an exception after its final-layer append consumes that owner, not its snapshots.
This experiment changes GEMM/SDPA shapes; real-arithmetic equivalence is not a
claim of bit-identical floating-point outputs, dispatch or a measured speed gain.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import cast

import torch
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache, DynamicLayer
from transformers.integrations.sdpa_attention import (
    sdpa_attention_forward as sdpa_attention_forward,
)
from transformers.models.qwen3.modeling_qwen3 import (
    Qwen3DecoderLayer,
    Qwen3RMSNorm,
    rotate_half,
)

# Narrow the maintained untyped rotation boundary, not its implementation.
rotate = cast(Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor], rotate_half)


def _validate(
    block: Qwen3DecoderLayer,
    norm: Qwen3RMSNorm,
    hidden: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
    cache: DynamicCache,
    prefix_length: int,
) -> None:
    if (
        type(embeddings) is not tuple
        or len(embeddings) != 2
        or any(not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) for value in embeddings)
    ):
        raise ValueError("RoPE requires exactly two maintained tensors")
    config = block.self_attn.config
    rotary, layer_types = config.rope_parameters, config.layer_types
    if (
        type(block) is not Qwen3DecoderLayer
        or type(norm) is not Qwen3RMSNorm
        or tuple(norm.weight.shape) != (config.hidden_size,)
        or torch.is_autocast_enabled("cpu")
        or config._attn_implementation != "sdpa"
        or not isinstance(rotary, dict)
        or rotary.get("rope_type", "default") != "default"
        or layer_types is None
        or any(kind != "full_attention" for kind in layer_types)
        or block.self_attn.layer_idx != config.num_hidden_layers - 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("Readouts require stock final CPU FP32 SDPA/default RoPE")
    modules = (*block.modules(), *norm.modules())
    if any(
        module.training or module._forward_hooks or module._forward_pre_hooks
        for module in modules
    ) or any(
        value.device.type != "cpu" or value.dtype != torch.float32
        for module in (block, norm)
        for value in (*module.parameters(), *module.buffers())
    ):
        raise ValueError("Readouts require unhooked eval FP32 CPU modules")
    if (
        hidden.device.type != "cpu"
        or hidden.dtype != torch.float32
        or hidden.requires_grad
        or hidden.ndim != 3
        or hidden.shape[0] < 1
        or hidden.shape[1] < 1
        or hidden.shape[2] != config.hidden_size
        or positions.device.type != "cpu"
        or positions.dtype != torch.long
        or positions.ndim != 2
        or positions.shape[0] != hidden.shape[0]
        or positions.shape[1] < 1
        or torch.any(positions < 0).item()
        or torch.any(positions >= hidden.shape[1]).item()
        or type(prefix_length) is not int
        or prefix_length < 0
    ):
        raise ValueError("Readouts require valid CPU suffix rows and ordered indices")
    if (
        type(cache) is not DynamicCache
        or len(cache.layers) != config.num_hidden_layers
        or any(type(layer) is not DynamicLayer for layer in cache.layers)
        or cache.get_seq_length(block.self_attn.layer_idx) != prefix_length
    ):
        raise ValueError("Readouts require a fresh stock final-layer prefix cache")
    layer = cast(DynamicLayer, cache.layers[block.self_attn.layer_idx])
    for state in (layer.keys, layer.values):
        if prefix_length and (
            state is None
            or tuple(state.shape)
            != (
                hidden.shape[0],
                config.num_key_value_heads,
                prefix_length,
                config.head_dim,
            )
            or state.device.type != "cpu"
            or state.dtype != torch.float32
            or state.stride(-1) != 1
        ):
            raise ValueError("Final prefix K/V must retain every FP32 token/head")
    for value in embeddings:
        if (
            value.device.type != "cpu"
            or value.dtype != torch.float32
            or value.ndim != 3
            or value.shape[0] not in (1, hidden.shape[0])
            or tuple(value.shape[1:]) != (hidden.shape[1], config.head_dim)
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "RoPE must cover the full suffix at its absolute positions"
            )


def _rotate(
    value: torch.Tensor, cosine: torch.Tensor, sine: torch.Tensor
) -> torch.Tensor:
    # Maintained Qwen3 rotation, separately shaped for selected Q and full K.
    return value * cosine[:, None] + rotate(value) * sine[:, None]


def selected_last_block(
    block: Qwen3DecoderLayer,
    norm: Qwen3RMSNorm,
    hidden: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
    cache: DynamicCache,
    *,
    prefix_length: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Return normalized ordered readouts; duplicates are preserved, never deduped."""
    _validate(block, norm, hidden, positions, position_embeddings, cache, prefix_length)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        batch, length, _ = hidden.shape
        rows = torch.arange(batch)[:, None]
        residual = hidden[rows, positions]
        normalized = block.input_layernorm(hidden)
        attention = block.self_attn
        head_dim = attention.head_dim
        query = attention.q_norm(
            attention.q_proj(normalized[rows, positions]).view(
                batch,
                positions.shape[1],
                attention.config.num_attention_heads,
                head_dim,
            )
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        key = attention.k_norm(
            attention.k_proj(normalized).view(batch, length, -1, head_dim)
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        value = (
            attention.v_proj(normalized)
            .view(batch, length, -1, head_dim)
            .transpose(1, 2)
        )
        cosine, sine = (value.expand(batch, -1, -1) for value in position_embeddings)
        query = _rotate(query, cosine[rows, positions], sine[rows, positions])
        key = _rotate(key, cosine, sine)
        key, value = cache.update(key, value, attention.layer_idx)
        mask = torch.arange(prefix_length + length)[None, None, None, :] <= (
            prefix_length + positions[:, None, :, None]
        )
        attended, _ = sdpa_attention_forward(
            attention,
            query,
            key,
            value,
            mask,
            dropout=0.0,
            scaling=attention.scaling,
            is_causal=False,
        )
        attended = attended.reshape(batch, positions.shape[1], -1).contiguous()
        selected = residual + attention.o_proj(attended)
        selected = selected + block.mlp(block.post_attention_layernorm(selected))
        return cast(torch.Tensor, norm(selected))

"""Scalar full77 confirmation against retained prefix; no production promotion."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sys
import time
from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from dataclasses import asdict
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

import torch
from transformers.integrations import sdpa_attention

from benchmarks.analysis.evidence import freeze_sources, process_diagnostic
from benchmarks.analysis.reference import read_reference
from benchmarks.analysis.torch.prefix.production import study as original
from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch
from wyat import Model
from wyat.backends.kai.cpu.prefix import PrefixScorer
from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import BenchmarkCycle, BenchmarkEngine, QualityGate, compare_cycles
from wyat.benchmark import _run as _run
from wyat.evaluation import _input_digest, case_from_dict
from wyat.wire import decode_json, read_object

from . import study as screen
from .scorer import SelectedScorer

SCREEN_HISTORY = {
    "torch-readout-first8-review.json": (
        "b42ef790a0de67ddddc4265946e3d478e11dafcc8b05fb6b55eda2653a4040cd"
    ),
    "torch-readout-first8-review.execution.json": (
        "93c802f6f471008d990eac1cd7cff754fb19774fe2f9839a2822328d2a55213b"
    ),
    "torch-readout-first8.json": (
        "a57e8b52ae727ca954dc8f943d1eb6cdbbd622fb4a3cc6f9304e67158f249858"
    ),
    "torch-readout-first8.wall.json": (
        "ba5f7f489848a2ca891ac3c4e3852839fa3b08a336ef7197a1638e2d7a4cb7c3"
    ),
    "torch-readout-first8.cycles.jsonl": (
        "60edf2a08ecbd71f3adbc747eb28a7a7c2969363d9f79149e43f482d8ef30e0d"
    ),
    "torch-readout-first8.sources-7a31a5ea873ab0e2.json": (
        "7a31a5ea873ab0e2199fbe9b8fc0f7f41fcd3c1502703407f22a66930c85fdac"
    ),
}
SCHEDULE = (
    ("screen", "retained"),
    ("screen", "selected"),
    ("warmup", "retained"),
    ("warmup", "selected"),
    *(
        ("measured", arm)
        for pair in range(5)
        for arm in (
            ("retained", "selected") if pair % 2 == 0 else ("selected", "retained")
        )
    ),
)


def admit_screen() -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Old capture identity comes from its archive, not expanded current globs."""
    prefix = screen.admit_history()
    original.verify_files(
        {original.RESULTS / name: sha for name, sha in SCREEN_HISTORY.items()}
    )
    saved = read_object(original.RESULTS / "torch-readout-first8.json")
    archive = read_object(
        original.RESULTS / next(name for name in SCREEN_HISTORY if ".sources-" in name)
    )
    files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], archive["files"])
    table: dict[str, str] = {}
    for item in files:
        sha = hashlib.sha256(cast(str, item["text"]).encode()).hexdigest()
        if sha != item["sha256"] or item["name"] in table:
            raise ValueError("Executed screen archive identity differs")
        table[cast(str, item["name"])] = sha
    if (
        saved["source_sha256"] != table
        or saved["completed"] is not True
        or saved["quality_passed"] is not True
        or saved["dispatch_passed"] is not True
        or saved["accepted"] is not False
        or saved["performance_passed"] is not False
        or saved["model_id"] != original.MODEL_ID
        or saved["dataset_sha256"] != original.DATA_SHA
        or saved["reference_sha256"] != original.REFERENCE_SHA
        or saved["full_input_sha256"] != original.INPUT_SHA
        or tuple(cast(list[int], saved["prefix_tokens"])) != prefix
    ):
        raise ValueError("Required first8 quality/dispatch evidence differs")
    review = read_object(original.RESULTS / "torch-readout-first8-review.json")
    if (
        review["audit_passed"] is not True
        or review["independent_quality_passed"] is not True
        or review["independent_dispatch_passed"] is not True
        or review["raw_outcomes"] != 88
        or review["main_sha256"] != SCREEN_HISTORY["torch-readout-first8.json"]
        or review["source_archive_sha256"]
        != SCREEN_HISTORY["torch-readout-first8.sources-7a31a5ea873ab0e2.json"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Independent first8 raw audit did not pass")
    return prefix


def source_paths() -> dict[str, Path]:
    paths = screen.source_paths()
    for name in (
        "docs/analysis/cpu/readout/confirm.md",
        "tests/analysis/cpu/readout/test_confirm.py",
    ):
        paths[name] = original.ROOT / name
    return paths


def study(model: Path, output: Path) -> bool:
    if (
        output.exists()
        or output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").exists()
        or any(output.parent.glob(output.stem + ".sources-*.json"))
    ):
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing receipts; choose a new output")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gate = QualityGate()
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "scope": (
            "Scalar full77 selected-last-block versus retained prefix; "
            "development exposure unknown"
        ),
        "batch_size": 1,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "performance_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "threads_restored": False,
        "dispatch_observed": False,
        "phase": "admission",
        "cycles": rows,
        "pending_cohorts": list(range(14)),
        "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
        "performance_gate": {
            "paired_median_minimum": 1.02,
            "paired_p05_minimum_exclusive": 1.0,
            "aggregate_throughput_ratio_minimum_exclusive": 1.0,
            "candidate_cohort_p95_maximum_ratio": 1.0,
        },
        "protocol": {
            "schedule": [list(item) for item in SCHEDULE],
            "outcomes": 1078,
            "device": "cpu",
            "dtype": "float32",
            "threads": 8,
            "prefix_length": 25,
            "max_length": 512,
            "token_cache_size": 0,
            "timing": (
                "Complete ordinary cohorts; fresh cache inside calls; "
                "setup/hash/journal outside metric"
            ),
            "dispatch_scope": "Prior first8 B8 profiles only; scalar calls unprofiled",
            "promotion": (
                "Scalar pass requires separate B8 confirmation; no production change"
            ),
        },
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    with output.open("x") as initial:
        initial.write(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    previous = torch.get_num_threads()
    restored = False

    def restore() -> None:
        nonlocal restored
        restored = True
        try:
            torch.set_num_threads(previous)
            if torch.get_num_threads() != previous:
                raise ValueError("Original process thread count was not restored")
        except BaseException as error:
            payload["thread_restoration_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
            raise
        payload["threads_restored"] = True

    try:
        prefix = admit_screen()
        inputs = {
            original.DATA: original.DATA_SHA,
            original.REFERENCE: original.REFERENCE_SHA,
        }
        inputs.update({model / name: sha for name, sha in original.MODEL_FILES.items()})
        original.verify_files(inputs)
        sources = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        policy = original.process_policy()
        flags = {
            name: vars(sdpa_attention)[name]
            for name in (
                "_is_torch_mps_available",
                "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13",
            )
        }
        history = (
            original.HISTORY
            | screen.HISTORY
            | SCREEN_HISTORY
            | {screen.CORE: screen.CORE_SHA}
        )
        payload.update(
            source_sha256=sources.hashes(),
            source_archive=sources.archive(),
            historical_sha256=history,
            asset_sha256={str(path): sha for path, sha in inputs.items()},
            process_policy=policy,
            sdpa_flags=flags,
            runtime={
                "python": sys.version,
                "executable": sys.executable,
                "platform": platform.platform(),
                "torch_git_version": torch.version.git_version,
                "torch_build": torch.__config__.show(),
                "prior_threads": previous,
                "interop_threads": torch.get_num_interop_threads(),
                "packages": {
                    name: version(name)
                    for name in (
                        "torch",
                        "transformers",
                        "tokenizers",
                        "safetensors",
                        "numpy",
                    )
                },
            },
            source_scope=(
                "On-disk Python/dependency source and runtime metadata; "
                "native binaries/imported objects not independently attested"
            ),
            phase="loading",
        )
        write()
        if not all(value is True for value in flags.values()):
            raise ValueError(
                "Native masked-GQA flags differ; no policy mutation allowed"
            )
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in original.DATA.read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77 or _input_digest(cases) != original.INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("All original ordered77 requests required")
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        if base.model_id != original.MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Released model identity differs")
        reference = read_reference(
            original.REFERENCE, cases, base, dataset_sha256=original.DATA_SHA
        )
        encoded = tuple(base.encode_request(case.request) for case in cases)
        resources: list[PrefixScorer] = []
        build: list[float] = []
        for kind in (PrefixScorer, SelectedScorer):
            started = time.perf_counter_ns()
            resources.append(kind(base, prefix))
            build.append((time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6)
        if not all(resource._admits(row) for resource in resources for row in encoded):
            raise ValueError(
                "Every original encoding must admit the frozen exact prefix"
            )
        payload.update(
            model_id=base.model_id,
            dataset_sha256=original.DATA_SHA,
            reference_sha256=original.REFERENCE_SHA,
            input_sha256=original.INPUT_SHA,
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            prefix_tokens=list(prefix),
            token_lengths=[len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
            prefix_state_bytes=[resource.prefix_state_bytes for resource in resources],
            prefix_build_ms=build,
            phase="cycles",
        )
        write()
        engines = {
            "retained": BenchmarkEngine(
                "retained", Model(resources[0], base.model_id), 1
            ),
            "selected": BenchmarkEngine(
                "selected", Model(resources[1], base.model_id), 1
            ),
        }
        measured: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"retained": [], "selected": []}
        anchors: dict[str, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
        observed: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []

        def verify() -> None:
            original.verify_sources(sources)
            original.verify_files(
                {original.RESULTS / name: sha for name, sha in history.items()}
            )
            if original.process_policy() != policy or torch.get_num_threads() != 8:
                raise ValueError("Owned process policy or threads changed")

        with output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").open("x") as journal:
            for index, (stage, arm) in enumerate(SCHEDULE):
                verify()
                before = process_diagnostic()
                cycle = _run(engines[arm], cases)
                row: dict[str, object] = {
                    "index": index,
                    "stage": stage,
                    "arm": arm,
                    "cycle": original.json_cycle(cycle),
                    "before": asdict(before),
                    "after": asdict(process_diagnostic()),
                    "unknown_case_ids": [
                        case.id
                        for case in cases
                        if not any(
                            item.id == case.id
                            and item.status == "ok"
                            and item.prediction is not None
                            for item in cycle.rows
                        )
                    ],
                }
                rows.append(row)
                payload["pending_cohorts"] = list(range(index + 1, 14))
                journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                journal.flush()
                write()
                original.require_timing(cycle)
                quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), gate)
                reports = [
                    compare_cycles((anchor,), (cycle,), gate)
                    for anchor in anchors.values()
                ]
                row["reference_quality"] = asdict(quality)
                row["anchor_quality"] = [asdict(report) for report in reports]
                write()
                if (
                    not quality.passed
                    or any(not report.passed for report in reports)
                    or cycle.failed
                    or cycle.correct != reference.correct
                ):
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Cohort numerical/rank/failure/accuracy gate failed"
                    )
                anchors.setdefault(arm, cycle)
                observed.append(cycle)
                if stage == "measured":
                    measured[arm].append(cycle)
                verify()
        quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * 14, observed, gate)
        paired = compare_cycles(measured["retained"], measured["selected"], gate)
        performance = original.performance(measured["retained"], measured["selected"])
        verify()
        original.verify_files(inputs)
        restore()
        passed = quality.passed and paired.passed
        speed = original.speed_passed(performance)
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=passed,
            performance_passed=speed,
            accepted=passed and speed,
            phase="complete",
            reference_quality=asdict(quality),
            paired_quality=asdict(paired),
            performance_observed=performance,
            source_verified_after=True,
            asset_verified_after=True,
            limits=(
                "Development77 scalar assay; sample p05 is not a confidence bound. "
                "No timed dispatch, peak-memory, held-out quality "
                "or production promotion claim."
            ),
        )
        write()
        # Performance negatives are complete scientific observations, not crashes.
        return passed
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            performance_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        raise
    finally:
        if not restored:
            try:
                restore()
                write()
            except BaseException:
                payload.update(
                    completed=False,
                    quality_passed=False,
                    performance_passed=False,
                    accepted=False,
                    phase="failed",
                )
                write()
                raise


class Arguments(Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path
    worker: bool


def main() -> None:
    parser = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help="internal owned worker")

    raise SystemExit(

            timeout=180,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Temporary CPU endpoint candidate; production retained-prefix scoring is unchanged."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import cast

import torch
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache
from transformers.masking_utils import create_causal_mask
from transformers.models.qwen3.modeling_qwen3 import Qwen3DecoderLayer

from wyat.backends.kai.cpu.prefix import PrefixScorer
from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.core import Request

from .block import selected_last_block


def selected_hidden(
    base: KaiScorer,
    ids: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    cache: DynamicCache,
    prefix_length: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Run stock early blocks; capture positions/mask before any cache append."""
    backbone = base.backbone
    if cache.get_seq_length() != prefix_length:
        raise ValueError("Selected scoring requires a fresh complete prefix owner")
    hidden = cast(torch.Tensor, backbone.embed_tokens(ids))
    position_ids = (torch.arange(ids.shape[1]) + prefix_length)[None]
    mask = create_causal_mask(
        config=backbone.config,
        inputs_embeds=hidden,
        attention_mask=None,
        past_key_values=cache,
        position_ids=position_ids,
    )
    embeddings = cast(
        tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor], backbone.rotary_emb(hidden, position_ids)
    )
    for layer in backbone.layers[:-1]:
        hidden = cast(
            torch.Tensor,
            layer(
                hidden,
                attention_mask=mask,
                position_ids=position_ids,
                past_key_values=cache,
                use_cache=True,
                position_embeddings=embeddings,
            ),
        )
    return selected_last_block(
        cast(Qwen3DecoderLayer, backbone.layers[-1]),
        backbone.norm,
        hidden,
        positions,
        embeddings,
        cache,
        prefix_length=prefix_length,
    )


class SelectedScorer(PrefixScorer):
    """Independent eager snapshots and per-call disposable caches; no routing change.

    This experimental copy owns only admitted tensor packing/forward/readout.
    Whole-batch fallback uses the original production tensor owner. It earns a
    production boundary only after separately reviewed full77 confirmation.
    """

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
        self._require_no_autocast()
        self._require_no_hooks(self.base)
        if not requests:
            return []
        encoded = [self.base.encode_request(request) for request in requests]
        if not all(self._admits(row) for row in encoded):
            return self.base._score_encoded(encoded)
        prefix_length = len(self.prefix)
        batch = len(encoded)
        length = max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded) - prefix_length
        width = max(len(row.candidate_positions) for row in encoded)
        ids = torch.full((batch, length), self.base.pad_id, dtype=torch.long)
        positions = torch.zeros((batch, width + 1), dtype=torch.long)
        for index, row in enumerate(encoded):
            suffix = row.ids[prefix_length:]
            ids[index, : len(suffix)] = torch.tensor(suffix, dtype=torch.long)
            positions[index, : len(row.candidate_positions)] = torch.tensor(
                [value - prefix_length for value in row.candidate_positions]
            )
            positions[index, -1] = row.query_position - prefix_length
        with torch.inference_mode():
            hidden = selected_hidden(
                self.base, ids, positions, self._fork(batch), prefix_length
            )
            logits = cast(torch.Tensor, self.base.head(hidden[:, :-1], hidden[:, -1]))
        values = cast(list[list[float]], logits.float().cpu().tolist())
        return [
            row[: len(item.candidate_positions)]
            for row, item in zip(values, encoded, strict=True)
        ]

"""Exploratory first8 endpoint screen; no speed or production promotion verdict."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib

ROOT = original.ROOT
CORE = "cpu-readout-core-review.json"

def admit_history() -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Pinned executed archives identify prior runs independently of live source."""
    prefix = original.admit_history()
    original.verify_files({original.RESULTS / CORE: CORE_SHA})
    core = read_object(original.RESULTS / CORE)
    if (
        core["passed"] is not True
        or core["scope_approved"] != "experimental_core_mechanics_only"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Independent mechanics review is unsupported")
    original.verify_files(
        {
            ROOT / name: sha
            for name, sha in cast(dict[str, str], core["source_sha256"]).items()
        }
    )
    original.verify_files(
        {
            ROOT / name: sha
            for name, sha in cast(
                dict[str, str], core["production_source_sha256"]
            ).items()
        }
    )
    original.verify_files(
        {original.RESULTS / name: sha for name, sha in HISTORY.items()}
    )
    archive = read_object(
        original.RESULTS / next(name for name in HISTORY if ".sources-" in name)
    )
    files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], archive["files"])
    table: dict[str, str] = {}
    for item in files:
        sha = hashlib.sha256(cast(str, item["text"]).encode()).hexdigest()
        if item["sha256"] != sha or item["name"] in table:
            raise ValueError("Historical archive identity differs")
        table[cast(str, item["name"])] = sha
    for batch in (8, 1):
        saved = read_object(
            original.RESULTS / f"torch-prefix-production77-b{batch}.json"
        )
        if (
            saved["completed"] is not True
            or saved["quality_passed"] is not True
            or saved["accepted"] is not True
            or saved["source_sha256"] != table
            or saved["model_id"] != original.MODEL_ID
            or saved["dataset_sha256"] != original.DATA_SHA
            or saved["reference_sha256"] != original.REFERENCE_SHA
            or saved["full_input_sha256"] != original.INPUT_SHA
            or tuple(cast(list[int], saved["prefix_tokens"])) != prefix
        ):
            raise ValueError("Final production prefix confirmation differs")
    return prefix


def source_paths() -> dict[str, Path]:
    paths = original.source_paths()
    for path in Path(__file__).parent.glob("*.py"):
        paths[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = path
    for name in (
        "docs/analysis/cpu/readout.md",
        "tests/analysis/cpu/readout/test_block.py",
        "tests/analysis/cpu/readout/test_screen.py",
    ):
        paths[name] = ROOT / name
    return paths


def profile_cycle(
    engine: BenchmarkEngine,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    retain: Callable[[BenchmarkCycle], None],
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    """Retain produced outputs before profiler exit; reduce only after it exits."""
    with torch.profiler.profile(
        activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU],
        record_shapes=True,
        with_stack=False,
        profile_memory=False,
    ) as profiler:
        retain(_run(engine, cases))
    averages = cast(
        Sequence[FunctionEventAvg], profiler.key_averages(group_by_input_shape=True)
    )
    return [
        {
            "operator": item.key,
            "count": item.count,
            "input_shapes": item.input_shapes,
            "self_cpu_time_us": float(item.self_cpu_time_total),
        }
        for item in averages
    ]


def dispatch(events: list[dict[str, object]], *, selected: bool) -> bool:
    """Observed exact native shapes/counts, rather than HF eligibility flags."""
    if any(
        item["operator"]
        in ("aten::_scaled_dot_product_attention_math", "aten::repeat_interleave")
        and cast(int, item["count"]) > 0
        for item in events
    ):
        return False
    flash = [
        item
        for item in events
        if item["operator"] == "aten::_scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_for_cpu"
    ]
    full = [
        [8, 16, 167, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [],
        [],
        [8, 1, 167, 192],
        [],
    ]
    short = [
        [8, 16, 7, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [],
        [],
        [8, 1, 7, 192],
        [],
    ]
    expected = [(full, 27), (short, 1)] if selected else [(full, 28)]
    return len(flash) == len(expected) and all(
        sum(cast(int, item["count"]) for item in flash if item["input_shapes"] == shape)
        == count
        for shape, count in expected
    )


def study(model: Path, output: Path) -> bool:
    if (
        output.exists()
        or output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").exists()
        or any(output.parent.glob(output.stem + ".sources-*.json"))
    ):
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing evidence; choose a new output")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    gate = QualityGate()
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "scope": (
            "Exploratory first8 CPU selected final readouts; "
            "development exposure unknown"
        ),
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "performance_passed": False,
        "threads_restored": False,
        "phase": "admission",
        "cycles": rows,
        "pending_cohorts": list(range(11)),
        "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
        "protocol": {
            "schedule": [list(item) for item in SCHEDULE],
            "outcomes": 88,
            "batch_size": 8,
            "dtype": "float32",
            "device": "cpu",
            "threads": 8,
            "max_length": 512,
            "token_cache_size": 0,
            "prefix_length": 25,
            "timing": (
                "Ordinary whole-cohort latency; profiler calls separate/intrusive"
            ),
            "promotion": (
                "None; full77 retained-relative B1/B8 confirmation required separately"
            ),
            "ownership": (
                "One shared base; two independent eager prefix "
                "snapshots; fresh per-call stock caches"
            ),
        },
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    with output.open("x") as initial:
        initial.write(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    previous = torch.get_num_threads()
    restored = False

    def restore() -> None:
        nonlocal restored
        restored = True
        try:
            torch.set_num_threads(previous)
            if torch.get_num_threads() != previous:
                raise ValueError("Original process thread count was not restored")
        except BaseException as error:
            payload["thread_restoration_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
            raise
        payload["threads_restored"] = True

    try:
        prefix = admit_history()
        inputs = {
            original.DATA: original.DATA_SHA,
            original.REFERENCE: original.REFERENCE_SHA,
        }
        inputs.update({model / name: sha for name, sha in original.MODEL_FILES.items()})
        original.verify_files(inputs)
        sources = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        policy = original.process_policy()
        flags = {
            name: vars(sdpa_attention)[name]
            for name in (
                "_is_torch_mps_available",
                "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13",
            )
        }
        payload.update(
            source_sha256=sources.hashes(),
            source_archive=sources.archive(),
            historical_sha256=HISTORY,
            original_historical_sha256=original.HISTORY,
            asset_sha256={str(path): sha for path, sha in inputs.items()},
            process_policy=policy,
            sdpa_flags=flags,
            runtime={
                "python": sys.version,
                "executable": sys.executable,
                "platform": platform.platform(),
                "torch_git_version": torch.version.git_version,
                "torch_build": torch.__config__.show(),
                "prior_threads": previous,
                "interop_threads": torch.get_num_interop_threads(),
                "packages": {
                    name: version(name)
                    for name in (
                        "torch",
                        "transformers",
                        "tokenizers",
                        "safetensors",
                        "numpy",
                    )
                },
            },
            source_scope=(
                "On-disk Python/dependency source and runtime metadata; "
                "native binaries/imported objects not independently attested"
            ),
            phase="loading",
        )
        write()
        if not all(value is True for value in flags.values()):
            raise ValueError(
                "Native masked-GQA context differs; do not patch eligibility flags"
            )
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        all_cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in original.DATA.read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(all_cases) != 77 or _input_digest(all_cases) != original.INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("All original ordered77 requests required")
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        if base.model_id != original.MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Released model identity differs")
        reference = read_reference(
            original.REFERENCE, all_cases, base, dataset_sha256=original.DATA_SHA
        )
        encoded = tuple(base.encode_request(case.request) for case in all_cases)
        resources: list[PrefixScorer] = []
        build: list[float] = []
        for kind in (PrefixScorer, SelectedScorer):
            started = time.perf_counter_ns()
            resources.append(kind(base, prefix))
            build.append((time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6)
        if not all(resource._admits(row) for resource in resources for row in encoded):
            raise ValueError(
                "All77 original encodings must admit the exact frozen prefix"
            )
        cases = all_cases[:8]
        reference = BenchmarkCycle(0, reference.rows[:8], 0, 0)
        if max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded[:8]) != 192 or any(
            len(row.candidate_positions) != 6 for row in encoded[:8]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Fixed first8 geometry differs")
        payload.update(
            model_id=base.model_id,
            dataset_sha256=original.DATA_SHA,
            reference_sha256=original.REFERENCE_SHA,
            input_sha256=_input_digest(cases),
            full_input_sha256=original.INPUT_SHA,
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            prefix_tokens=list(prefix),
            token_lengths=[len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
            prefix_state_bytes=[resource.prefix_state_bytes for resource in resources],
            prefix_build_ms=build,
            phase="cycles",
        )
        write()
        engines = {
            "original": BenchmarkEngine("original", Model(base, base.model_id), 8),
            "retained": BenchmarkEngine(
                "retained", Model(resources[0], base.model_id), 8
            ),
            "selected": BenchmarkEngine(
                "selected", Model(resources[1], base.model_id), 8
            ),
        }
        observed: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
        anchors: dict[str, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
        profiled: dict[str, bool] = {}

        def verify() -> None:
            original.verify_sources(sources)
            original.verify_files({original.RESULTS / CORE: CORE_SHA})
            original.verify_files(
                {
                    original.RESULTS / name: sha
                    for name, sha in (original.HISTORY | HISTORY).items()
                }
            )
            if original.process_policy() != policy or torch.get_num_threads() != 8:
                raise ValueError("Owned process policy or threads changed")

        with output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").open("x") as journal:
            for index, (stage, arm) in enumerate(SCHEDULE):
                verify()
                before = process_diagnostic()
                cycle: BenchmarkCycle | None = None
                events: list[dict[str, object]] = []

                def retain(value: BenchmarkCycle) -> None:
                    nonlocal cycle
                    cycle = value

                error: BaseException | None = None
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                try:
                    if stage == "profile":
                        events = profile_cycle(engines[arm], cases, retain)
                    else:
                        retain(_run(engines[arm], cases))
                except BaseException as failure:
                    error = failure
                outer_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
                if cycle is not None:
                    row: dict[str, object] = {
                        "index": index,
                        "stage": stage,
                        "arm": arm,
                        "cycle": original.json_cycle(cycle),
                        "outer_wall_ms": outer_ms,
                        "before": asdict(before),
                        "after": asdict(process_diagnostic()),
                        "operator_self_times": events,
                        "unknown_case_ids": [
                            case.id
                            for case in cases
                            if not any(
                                item.id == case.id
                                and item.status == "ok"
                                and item.prediction is not None
                                for item in cycle.rows
                            )
                        ],
                    }
                    for event in events:
                        value = cast(float, event["self_cpu_time_us"])
                        if not math.isfinite(value):
                            event.update(
                                self_cpu_time_us=None, invalid_timing=repr(value)
                            )
                    if error is not None:
                        row["capture_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
                    rows.append(row)
                    payload["pending_cohorts"] = list(range(index + 1, 11))
                    # One immutable raw journal entry, before any comparison.
                    # Main rows subsequently add quality reports; raw fields agree.
                    journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    journal.flush()
                    write()
                    original.require_timing(cycle)
                    quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), gate)
                    comparisons = [
                        compare_cycles((anchor,), (cycle,), gate)
                        for anchor in anchors.values()
                    ]
                    row["reference_quality"] = asdict(quality)
                    row["anchor_quality"] = [asdict(report) for report in comparisons]
                    write()
                    if (
                        not quality.passed
                        or any(not report.passed for report in comparisons)
                        or cycle.failed
                        or cycle.correct != reference.correct
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Cohort numerical/rank/failure/accuracy gate failed"
                        )
                    anchors.setdefault(arm, cycle)
                    if any(event["self_cpu_time_us"] is None for event in events):
                        raise ValueError("Profile clock evidence is nonfinite")
                    observed.append(cycle)
                    if stage == "profile":
                        profiled[arm] = dispatch(events, selected=arm == "selected")
                    verify()
                if error is not None:
                    raise error
                if cycle is None:
                    raise ValueError("Cohort did not return raw outcomes")
        quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * 11, tuple(observed), gate)
        pairs = [
            compare_cycles(
                (observed[3], observed[8]), (observed[4], observed[7]), gate
            ),
            compare_cycles(
                (observed[3], observed[8]), (observed[5], observed[6]), gate
            ),
            compare_cycles(
                (observed[4], observed[7]), (observed[5], observed[6]), gate
            ),
        ]
        verify()
        original.verify_files(inputs)
        restore()
        passed = quality.passed and all(pair.passed for pair in pairs)
        dispatch_passed = profiled == {"retained": True, "selected": True}
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=passed,
            dispatch_passed=dispatch_passed,
            phase="complete",
            reference_quality=asdict(quality),
            paired_quality=[asdict(pair) for pair in pairs],
            ordinary_times_ms={
                arm: [
                    cycle.latency_ms
                    for (_, name), cycle in zip(
                        SCHEDULE[3:9], observed[3:9], strict=True
                    )
                    if name == arm
                ]
                for arm in engines
            },
            source_verified_after=True,
            asset_verified_after=True,
            limits=(
                "Two ordinary observations per arm; no speed gate, "
                "full77/held-out/peak-memory/online claim. Profiles intrusive; "
                "grouped self times are not per-layer ordinary fractions."
            ),
        )
        write()
        return passed and dispatch_passed
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            dispatch_passed=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        raise
    finally:
        if not restored:
            try:
                restore()
                write()
            except BaseException:
                payload.update(
                    completed=False,
                    quality_passed=False,
                    dispatch_passed=False,
                    phase="failed",
                )
                write()
                raise
